data.name: Jagdish
data.gender_notes: Jagdish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit jagat, 'world', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the world'. Its root is Sanskrit jagat + īśa. A classical Sanskrit epithet of God. Jagdish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of the world”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jagdish expresses “Lord of the world”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit jagat, 'world', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of the world'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagdish total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
